bbox_xyxy2xywh: create a function that converts bounding boxes from x1y1x2y2 format to xywh format
bbox_xywh2xyxy: create a function that converts bounding boxes from xywh format to x1y1x2y2 format
bbox_xyxy2cs: create a function that transforms bounding boxes from x1y1x2y2 format to center and scale
bbox_xywh2cs: create a function that transforms bounding boxes from xywh format to center and scale
flip_bbox: create a function that flips bounding boxes horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
